name: Ro Khanna

name: Steve Scalise
notes: PAC filings report $1,894,680 in contributions to Scalise for Congress. The campaign's own FEC summary lists $187,000 received directly from PACs and $11,995,969 in transfers from authorized and joint fundraising committees. The difference likely reflects PAC money routed through joint fundraising.
